name: School Speed Limit
author: daddybannk
queryHints:
Join camera_log to vehicles on
the plate, then to drivers.

Two windows, so two time ranges
joined with OR.

Over the limit means speed > 40,
not 40 itself.
caseHints:
06:00-08:00 and 15:00-17:00,
max 40 km/h. Times are HHMM.

Both windows include their own
end times.
